kind: Spectra STANDARD all available CPU qualification
result: pass: fixed Suite 3 reference, current Kernel 0.1.331 SMP4, native 16 and native 4 runs; complete original exports and DevCenter readbacks validated

method.work: One equal fixed-work participant per available schedulable CPU in each of the five areas. Scheduler owns placement; no affinity or CPU reservation guarantee.
method.interval: Common start gate after all preparation and scheduler-peer readiness; end after actual participant cleanup and joins. Shared wall time divided by all completed operations.
method.warmup: At least one second active work and three complete fixed batches; then five measurement batches per area. All warmup work retained.
method.failure_bounds: 30 seconds per batch, 90 per warmup, 300 per suite and 360 for its foreground wrapper, multiplied by max(1, ceil(CPUs/4)). No speed gate.
method.evidence: Every successful raw sample proves worker_count=completed_workers=available CPU count. Work and bytes are per-CPU amounts times that count.
method.comparison: Fixed workload, fixture hash and measurement protocol must match. CPU count, RAM, storage, native/VM and boot context remain measured variables. Historical Suite1/2 descriptors are byte-identical and are never rescored as Suite3.

kernel_fix.cause: An IF=0 demand fault waiting for a memory owner could prevent the TLB acknowledgement awaited by the other CPU holding that owner.
kernel_fix.change: While contending with IF=0, service only the pending lock-free TLB generation. Keep IRQ flags and owners; do not consume the isolated missing-ACK injection.
kernel_fix.scope: Private memory-owner/TLB implementation; no API, ABI, SDK or Contract changes.

stream_capacity_fix.cause: The global 16 stream slots include the export stream, leaving insufficient space for 16 simultaneous filesystem participants.
stream_capacity_fix.change: Kernel 0.1.331 uses a single CAPACITY=2*MAX_CPUS=64 for payloads, ownership projections, every search and every exact retirement scan. Per-volume retirement masks use 64 bits; a compile-time bound prevents truncation.
stream_capacity_fix.validation: Only the affected filesystem area was rechecked on native 16 before the final full run; all six samples completed 16/16 participants with original work and cleanup checks. No I/O failure is retried or ignored.

targeted_validation.spectra: Existing owner Zig and PowerShell contracts pass, including scaled complete work and rejecting incomplete participants. Synthetic contract fixtures were not imported into DevCenter.
targeted_validation.devcenter: 24 existing owner tests pass, including native-vs-VM comparison, lossless worker counters, rejected incomplete workers and historical comparison behavior.
targeted_validation.kernel: Build and formatting pass; current Test image contains the exact final ELF; existing short SMP4 acceptance passes, including actual remote TLB invalidation and missing-ACK retention.
targeted_validation.native_cancellation: On Kernel 0.1.330 with unchanged final Spectra 0.1.24, existing CHECK LIFECYCLE /STANDARDCANCEL passes: exit 4, owner-blocks 0 and reaped handle not found.
targeted_validation.policy: Only relevant existing checks were used; no broad test catalog or unrelated graphics tests.
